## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] Behaviour change is covered by a test that **fails on the old code**
- [ ] Docs updated if this changes a user-facing API (`npm run lint:drift`
      catches docs that no longer tell the truth)
- [ ] No direct DOM manipulation -- TACO and `bw.mount()` / `bw.el()` only
- [ ] No `data-*` attributes and no CSS custom properties in library source
- [ ] **`dist/` is not committed.** Built artifacts are generated by the
      release pipeline; a PR that includes them will conflict
